title: Highest temperature in London on August 23?
description:
This market will resolve based on the highest temperature recorded in the 'Daily Observations' table on Weather Underground, not the figure displayed in the 'Day High & Low' summary section; in the event of any discrepancy between the two, the Daily Observations table shall be the primary resolution source not the Day High & Low section.

This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the London City Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 23 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the London City Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/gb/london/EGLC.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description:
**Forecast consensus from multiple models and agencies positions 34–35°C as the dominant outcomes for Ankara’s maximum temperature on August 23, 2026.** Official Turkish Meteorological Service (MGM) guidance and international sources (WeatherBug, Met Office, Yr.no) converge on afternoon highs of 33–35°C under mostly sunny to partly cloudy skies, with light northwesterly winds and very low humidity (15–25%). These conditions favor strong daytime heating over the Anatolian plateau’s continental climate, where clear skies and minimal cloud cover allow efficient solar insolation.

Recent observations reinforce this range: August 22 reached 34–35°C (94–95°F), and the pattern shows no significant cooling advection or moisture influx through the weekend. Ensemble model spreads remain narrow, with limited disagreement on peak values, keeping probabilities tightly clustered around the two leading bins. Resolution hinges on the official station reading (typically Esenboğa Airport or central Ankara), where even a 1°C model bias or local microclimate effect could shift the exact maximum between 34°C and 35°C.

Traders appear to weigh the slight edge toward 35°C from the warmest deterministic runs and recent observed warmth, while the 41.5% on 34°C reflects the broader ensemble mean and historical late-August averages near 32–34°C. With no major synoptic changes expected before resolution, the market reflects high-confidence scientific agreement on this narrow temperature window.

The resolution source for this market will be information from NOAA, specifically the highest reading under the "Temp" column for all times on this day, available here: https://www.weather.gov/wrh/timeseries?site=zhcc

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the "Switch to Metric Units" button until the relevant table displays °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: Current forecasts from multiple meteorological models indicate a high of 32–33°C for Zhengzhou on August 23 under typical late-summer East Asian monsoon conditions, with partly cloudy skies, thundershowers, and high humidity elevating heat indices. This consensus drives the 74% market-implied probability for 32°C or higher, consistent with August climatology of frequent daytime peaks near or above 32°C. Recent model runs show limited cooling from scattered precipitation, though steering patterns and any intensification of rain could shift outcomes toward the 31°C or 30°C brackets. Official observations tomorrow will resolve the market against these thresholds.
